# Doxumentation & paperwork
The following forms should be available for use within Science:
- [bold]Cyborg Conversion Form[/bold]: Records individual to be converted, the new chassis, authorization, and reasoning. - [bold]Request Form[/bold]: documentation of upgrades, distributed boards, and recipients. - [bold]Anomalous Host Form[/bold]: written informed consent for crew hosting anomalies. - [bold]Anomaly Research Log[/bold]: Documentation of anomaly research, including the anomaly's location, type, and any relevant information. All forms should be filed promptly in departmental records and made available for review by the RD, Command, or Internal Affairs.
